subject: general
question: Which of the following apps has been launched to make the Indian Parliament proceedings accessible to the public at large in January 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Digital Sansad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Digital Sansad** is the app launched to make the Indian Parliament proceedings accessible to the public.
 
• It was launched in January 2022.
 
• The app aims to bring the proceedings of Parliament closer to the citizens of India.
 
• It allows users to access various parliamentary documents, including speeches, debates, and questions raised by Members of Parliament.
 
• The app is part of the broader initiative to increase transparency and public engagement with the legislative process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The app is available for both Android and iOS platforms.
 
• It provides real-time updates on the proceedings of both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha.
 
• Users can also watch live telecasts of parliamentary sessions through the app.
 
• It includes features like search options, archived content, and notifications for important updates.
 
• The launch of the app aligns with the government's Digital India initiative aimed at promoting digital accessibility and transparency.
